index.title: Sixteen Thousand Parameters That Buy Nothing
index.prompt: Compare a frozen linear probe against the same head with a 128x128 linear adapter beneath it, and show that 26x the parameters buys no accuracy at any training-set size.
index.answer: Auto-graded inside the notebook. Both accuracy curves must match the reference solution to a relative tolerance of 1e-6, and the two curves must stay within 3 accuracy points of each other despite a 26x parameter difference.
